name: Check duplicate contact
description: Call this when you need to know whether a contact identifier (email, SMS number, WhatsApp number, landline number, or external ID) is already taken in the account, typically before attempting to create a contact so you can avoid a collision or decide to update instead. Supply at least one identifier; the endpoint rejects a call where all of them are empty. This only answers the duplicate question — use the contact creation action to actually add the contact, the contact update action to modify the existing one, or a contact search/listing action when you need the stored attributes of the matching contact rather than a yes/no answer.
preconditions: The caller must be authenticated as a user of the Brevo account whose contacts are being checked.
At least one of email, sms, whatsapp, landline_number or ext_id must be supplied and non-empty, otherwise the request fails with HTTP 400.

email.description: Email address to test for an existing contact. May be sent empty if another identifier is supplied.

sms.description: SMS phone number to test for an existing contact. May be sent empty if another identifier is supplied.

whatsapp.description: WhatsApp phone number to test for an existing contact. May be sent empty if another identifier is supplied.

landline_number.description: Landline phone number to test for an existing contact. May be sent empty if another identifier is supplied.

ext_id.description: External identifier (your own system's contact ID) to test for an existing contact. May be sent empty if another identifier is supplied.

message.description: Response payload. In the observed HTTP 400 case this is a JSON-encoded string containing a "response" field with the validation error, e.g. "Expected Email, sms, whatsapp, landline_number or ext_id all can not be empty.". The shape of a successful 200 response was not observed.
